name: TrueMile
long_description:
Drivers who own their trucks join our company and earn 30% more profit, while agents run our back office so one person can now manage 9x the amount of trucks. 

Companies that ship goods don't sign contracts with one-truck businesses. So these drivers contact brokers one by one, taking jobs as they become available. That's the trap. A job that looks great can strand you in a city where the next jobs pay less. Our AI negotiates brokers across 10 markets at once to weigh profit across the whole week, not just one job at a time.

Trucking is insanely hard to scale because more trucks always meant hiring more people. Now we're finally able to scale truck count without spending time, resources, and dollars hiring for the back-office.

Founder / CEO Harpreet is a data scientist who has generated over $7.2M in freight revenue. 

For owner-operators and freight partnerships: harpreet@truemile.ai

launches.tagline: Truck drivers earn more while doing less.
launches.body:
Hi, I’m Harpreet, founder of TrueMile.

**TL;DR:** TrueMile is a trucking company run by AI agents. Drivers who own their trucks join us and earn 30% more profit. One person can now manage 9x as many trucks. In the last 3 weeks, our AI booked $91K of freight revenue. Jobs our AI picks pay up to 17% more per mile than the market. Our trucks drive 10% more miles a month than the industry average by reducing empty time between jobs.

**The problem: drivers who own their trucks get the leftovers**

Companies that ship goods don't sign contracts with one-truck businesses. So these drivers contact brokers one by one, taking jobs as they become available. That's the trap. A job that looks great can leave you in a city where the next job pays less. Our AI negotiates with brokers across 10 markets at once to weigh profit across the whole week, not just one job at a time.

**How TrueMile works**

<https://youtu.be/MRmZpD42ov4>

TrueMile combines mathematical optimization with AI agents that execute:

* **Optimize the whole fleet.** Evaluate contracts, job assignments, and backhauls together weighing market forecasts, revenue, costs, available hours, and driver commitments.
* **Source and negotiate freight.** Search load boards and contact brokers in parallel to secure loads that fit the plan.
* **Execute and adapt.** Dispatch drivers, keep customers updated, and rework assignments when plans change.

**The result**

More revenue per truck. Lower costs. Higher margins. AI keeps trucks busy and lets us add trucks without adding office staff at the same pace. Customers get steady updates and on-time deliveries. Drivers earn more while doing less.

**The team**

[**Harpreet Dhaliwal**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harpreet-dhaliwal/) **(CEO)** Generated over $7.2M in freight revenue. Graduated at 20, MS in Data Science, and built software for mid-size trucking companies.

[**Daniyar Abykhanov**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniyarabykhanov/) **(founding engineer)**  played professional esports for Kazakhstan from ages 12-16. Built voice agents that replaced 225 people at Kazakhstan's largest bank. Back-to-back hackathon winner.

[**Mouha Mansour**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohamedali-benmansour) **(founding engineer)** wrote his MIT thesis on freight operations using C.H. Robinson data, the largest freight broker in the US.

**Our ask**

* Know drivers who own their trucks and want to earn more and do less? Send them to [harpreet@truemile.ai](mailto:harpreet@truemile.ai).
* Ship full truckloads on a regular schedule in Texas and the southern US? We're taking on two partners for regular routes this quarter. [Book a call](https://calendly.com/harpreet-truemile/30min).
* Know a logistics, supply chain, or transportation leader who's tired of trucks that don't show up? We’d love an intro: [harpreet@truemile.ai](mailto:harpreet@truemile.ai).

Learn more at [truemile.ai](http://truemile.ai).
